title: Canonical coordinate right comparisons
statement: Fix the prime, coefficient extension, coefficient-tower base and operations, and Tate-tower family of [def-sp-coordinate-adjunction-categories]. Using the categories and right functors of [def-sp-coordinate-adjunction-categories] and the tensor comparisons of [def-sp-coordinate-tate-tensor-comparisons], define PullTwist as an ordinary Tate-line pullback isomorphism together with the right-functor comparison fixed by tensor pullback, the shift comparison and the derived single-functor comparison. Define RootLines by finite Kummer isomorphisms normalized on root-limit projections and coefficient tensors. Define AffineRestriction by ordinary pullback of the projective line, normalized on the finite root tensors, together with the derived right-functor comparison fixed by pullback/tensor and total shift maps. Define the explicit successor coordinate isomorphism, both right evaluation arrows, and the zero-coordinate comparison from identity pullback, the coefficient unit and zero shift. No existence of these comparison data is asserted. The ordinary root-section adjunct and its diagonal line use [def-sp-tower-class-pullback] and [def-sp-tower-class-diagonal].
